# Results

## PCA ordination (all data and site effect partitioned out)

PCA of all plots: full ordination (left) and partial ordination with site effect removed (right).

```{r}
#| label: fig-pca-all-vs-no-site
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 12
#| fig-cap: "PCA ordination of ecosystem functions for all plots. Left: full ordination. Right: site effect partitioned out (within-site variation only). Sites are coloured by summer temperature and shaped by precipitation."

tar_read(pca_all_vs_no_site_plot)
```

Variation in ecosystem function composition explained by PERMANOVA for all plots and site-partitioned PCA: (1) climate only, (2) FG × climate + biomass, (3) biomass G/F/B × climate.

```{r}
#| label: tab-permanova-climate
#| echo: false
#| eval: false
#| tbl-cap: "Variance in ecosystem function composition explained by PERMANOVA (% R²). Values are grouped into Climate, FG, Biomass, and Residual for each model."

pca_all <- tar_read(pca_all)
pca_no_site <- tar_read(pca_no_site)

permanova_all <- pca_all[[4]]
permanova_no_site <- pca_no_site[[4]]

# [[4]] is a named list of adonis2 results.
# adonis2 is run with by = "terms", so each term has its own R2 row.
# We aggregate terms into Climate, FG, Biomass, and keep one Residual.
r2_by_term <- function(ad) {
  if (is.null(ad)) return(NULL)
  rn <- row.names(ad)
  r2 <- ad$R2
  climate_r2 <- 0
  fg_r2 <- 0
  biomass_r2 <- 0
  for (i in seq_along(rn)) {
    if (rn[i] %in% c("Residual", "Total")) next
    term <- rn[i]
    if (grepl("treatment", term, fixed = TRUE)) {
      fg_r2 <- fg_r2 + r2[i]
    } else if (grepl("total_biomass_scaled", term, fixed = TRUE) || grepl("biomass_scaled", term, fixed = TRUE)) {
      biomass_r2 <- biomass_r2 + r2[i]
    } else if (grepl("temperature_scaled", term, fixed = TRUE) || grepl("precipitation_scaled", term, fixed = TRUE)) {
      climate_r2 <- climate_r2 + r2[i]
    }
  }
  residual_r2 <- if ("Residual" %in% rn) ad["Residual", "R2"] else NA_real_
  list(
    climate_r2 = climate_r2 * 100,
    fg_r2 = fg_r2 * 100,
    biomass_r2 = biomass_r2 * 100,
    residual_r2 = residual_r2 * 100
  )
}
format_r2_num <- function(x, field) {
  if (is.null(x)) return(NA_real_)
  round(x[[field]], 1)
}

bind_rows(
  tibble(
    Dataset = "All data",
    Model = c("Climate only", "FG × climate + biomass", "Biomass G/F/B × climate"),
    name = c("climate", "fg_climate_biomass", "biomass_fg_climate"),
    res = map(name, ~ r2_by_term(permanova_all[[.x]]))
  ),
  tibble(
    Dataset = "Site partitioned out",
    Model = c("Climate only", "FG × climate + biomass", "Biomass G/F/B × climate"),
    name = c("climate", "fg_climate_biomass", "biomass_fg_climate"),
    res = map(name, ~ r2_by_term(permanova_no_site[[.x]]))
  )
) |>
  mutate(
    Climate = map_dbl(res, ~ format_r2_num(.x, "climate_r2")),
    FG = map_dbl(res, ~ format_r2_num(.x, "fg_r2")),
    Biomass = map_dbl(res, ~ format_r2_num(.x, "biomass_r2")),
    Residual = map_dbl(res, ~ format_r2_num(.x, "residual_r2"))
) |>
  select(Dataset, Model, Climate, FG, Biomass, Residual) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(columns = c(Climate, FG, Biomass, Residual), decimals = 1, pattern = "{x}%")
```
